layouts.guidance: Demonstrate safe traversal within the Top-edge corridor by staying on the initial top row toward the goal column, then descending along that column to the goal, under hazard placements that do not block the horizontal top-row path.
layouts.what_it_teaches: Reinforces corridor-following behavior and safe fire-avoidance within the Top-edge corridor, emphasizing early commitment to the horizontal path before descent.
layouts.rationale: Exemplifies horizontal top-row traversal along the Top-edge corridor while fires are placed off the direct horizontal path to highlight corridor adherence and hazard avoidance.

layouts.guidance: Demonstrate the vertical descent within the Top-edge corridor after aligning with the goal column, under hazard placements that permit a clear top-row traversal before descending.
layouts.what_it_teaches: Gives the agent practice in the vertical transition within the Top-edge corridor while maintaining avoidance of fires and avoiding detours that lead to hazards.
layouts.rationale: Exposes the vertical descent along the leftmost column in the Top-edge corridor, with fires placed off that descent path to emphasize corridor adherence and hazard avoidance during descent.
